about_the_game:
FPV Kamikaze Drone is a tactical game focused on the use of FPV drones in modern warfare. In single-player mode, players control a drone from a first-person view, practicing navigation, attack trajectories, and engagement of ground targets.

The game also supports co-op, allowing players to complete missions together and coordinate drone usage.

In multiplayer, players control a soldier in third-person view, move across the battlefield, search for FPV drones, and use them during combat against other players. Drones are an integrated part of the gameplay and are used directly during matches.
